articles.summary: NioCorp has reached a definitive agreement with Traxys North America LLC , resulting in 100% of the Company’s planned production from its Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project now being supported by commercial agreements during the first 15 years of operations.
articles.title: NioCorp Places 100% of Its Planned Critical Minerals Production Under Commercial Sales Agreements

articles.summary: NioCorp is pleased to announce that U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright, Export-Import Bank of the United States Chairman and President John Jovanovic, Nebraska Governor Jim Pillen, U.S. Senators Deb Fischer (R-NE) and Pete Ricketts (R-NE) and Congressman Adrian Smith (R-NE) will visit the Company’s Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project mine site in southeast Nebraska on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.
articles.title: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright, EXIM Chairman John Jovanovic, Nebraska Governor Jim Pillen, Senators Deb Fischer and Pete Ricketts, and Congressman Adrian Smith to Visit NioCorp’s Critical Minerals Mine Site
